summary: A 150-unit affordable apartment building at 1180 Fourth Street in Mission Bay South, for very-low- and low-income families and 50 formerly homeless households, developed by Mercy Housing California and designed by Kennerly Architecture & Planning with Mithun|Solomon. DataSF's Assessor tax roll records the parcel's construction year as 2015, and Mercy Housing held its official opening celebration on May 6, 2015.

milestones.text: Mercy Housing California holds the official opening celebration / dedication for 1180 Fourth Street, attended by the Mayor and District 6 Supervisor
DataSF's Assessor tax roll records the building's construction year
